setup: A disposable Go home uses a self-hosted streamable HTTP MCP disclosure service with an always-ask policy.
verified: The pending review contains only the selected reference, client, and total fields and the approved recipient.
The remote service receives one exact disclosure after approval.
The unselected account and internal note never enter the review or remote request.
The private source file remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
scope: Controlled MCP disclosure through the existing governed binding path. Recipient policy and human judgment remain represented by the configured review decision.
